answer: SybilShield 1. A new user, the echo, deposits 100 tokens to join. 2. Existing users, the tide, can vouch for the echo by staking 10 tokens. Each vouch adds to the echo's reputation. 3. If the echo is found to be a Sybil, its 100 tokens are slashed. Each vouching tide also loses 10% of their stake, cascading up their vouching chain. Cost for N identities: $100 + (N-1) $10 (initial deposit + vouching cost). Failure occurs if a coordinated group of tides collude to vouch for a Sybil echo, overwhelming the slashing penalty. This is like a single willow tree's strength amplified by its roots
